name: Release readiness brief
description: Turn release notes into a reviewable brief and flag explicitly blocked launches.

steps.name: Surface launch blocker
steps.template:
A blocker is recorded in the release notes. Confirm who owns it and when the release should be reviewed again.

{{steps.notes}}

steps.name: Draft release brief
steps.template:
Write a release readiness brief with four sections: scope, verification evidence, open issues, and the next decision. Treat the notes as the source of truth. Mark missing evidence as unknown and distinguish recorded test results from proposed checks.

{{steps.notes}}

steps.name: Review release brief
steps.template:
Approve this brief when the scope, evidence and remaining decision are described accurately.

{{steps.brief}}
